title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at Horizon Quantum, Quantum Computing Inc., and Uviquity - Quantum Computing Report
gist: A personnel roundup: Horizon Quantum promoted long-time internal product leader Amanda Chew to Chief Product Officer effective August 17, 2026; Quantum Computing Inc. promoted Mark Batzdorf, who arrived via the Luminar Semiconductor acquisition, to SVP Finance; and Uviquity added former Coherent Corp. Chair and CEO Vincent D. "Chuck" Mattera, Jr. as Strategic Advisor as it commercializes an aluminum nitride photonics platform.

insights.claim: Horizon Quantum appointed Amanda Chew as Chief Product Officer effective August 17, 2026, elevating an internal hire who joined in 2020 as Product Manager and rose through Director of Product and Vice President of Product after management roles at Microsoft.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Creating a CPO role and filling it internally suggests Horizon Quantum is shifting from research toward shipping a product line.
insights.locator: Opening paragraph — "Horizon Quantum has appointed Amanda Chew"

insights.claim: Chew's remit at Horizon Quantum covers product development and software infrastructure strategies, indicating a software-first rather than hardware-first orientation at the company.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Software-layer quantum companies monetize independently of hardware timelines — a different risk profile from qubit makers.
insights.locator: "In her new capacity, Chew will manage"

themes.theme: QCi finance and the Luminar Semiconductor integration

insights.claim: Quantum Computing Inc. promoted Mark Batzdorf to Senior Vice President, Finance; he joined QCi through its acquisition of Luminar Semiconductor and had been running finance for the company's photonics unit.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Promoting an acquired-company finance lead to group SVP signals the photonics unit is central to QCi's financial framework and growth planning, not a bolt-on.
insights.locator: "Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) has promoted Mark Batzdorf"

insights.claim: Uviquity appointed Dr. Vincent D. ("Chuck") Mattera, Jr. — Founder and CEO of Avalanche Thinking and former Chair and CEO of Coherent Corp. — as a Strategic Advisor.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Recruiting a former photonics-industry CEO is the classic pre-scaling move for a components startup seeking manufacturing and channel credibility.

insights.claim: Uviquity is commercializing an integrated aluminum nitride (AlN) photonics platform aimed at quantum computing, sensing and ultraviolet applications.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: AlN photonics spans quantum and UV markets, giving the company non-quantum revenue optionality while quantum demand matures.
insights.quote: as the company commercializes its integrated aluminum nitride (AlN) photonics platform for quantum computing, sensing, and ultraviolet applications
insights.locator: "In his advisory role, he will guide Uviquity’s executive team"
